analogy.rationale: SYK is a spleen tyrosine kinase with a restricted expression profile in these cell lines, so SYK inhibitors should elicit little transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other kinase inhibitors targeting related tyrosine kinase signaling (BTK, JAK) and ATPase inhibitors matching the annotated ATP5A1/B/C1 off-targets.
